record.paper_title: Noncommutative spectral geometry of Riemannian foliations: some results and open problems
record.context_brief: injectivity of completed principal symbol map
record.original_question: For the continuous principal symbol map sigma-bar: Psi-bar^{0,-infinity}(M, F, E) -> S-bar^0(G_FN, L(pi^*E) tensor |T G_N|^{1/2}) arising in transverse pseudodifferential calculus on a compact foliated manifold, which geometric or analytic hypotheses guarantee that sigma-bar is injective?

evidence.quote: We have much less information on the principal symbol map in transverse pseudodifferential calculus. For instance, answers to the following questions are unknown. Question 3.10. Under which conditions is the principal symbol map sigma-bar injective?

By [24], this homomorphism is surjective, but, in general, is not injective. It is injective for any E if the groupoid G is amenable... Therefore, if G is not amenable, we cannot expect that sigma-bar is injective.

artifact.self_contained_problem:
Let $(M,F)$ be a compact smooth manifold equipped with a Riemannian foliation $F$, and let $E \to M$ be a smooth Hermitian vector bundle. Let $G_F$ denote the holonomy groupoid of $(M,F)$ and let $G_{F_N}$ denote the associated transverse groupoid acting on the normal bundle $N = TM/TF$, with projection $\pi$ to its unit space. Consider the algebra $\Psi^{0,-\infty}(M,F,E)$ of transversal pseudodifferential operators of order $0$ acting on sections of $E$ in the transverse pseudodifferential calculus, and let $\overline{\Psi}^{0,-\infty}(M,F,E)$ be its completion in the $C^*$-algebra norm. Let $\overline{S}^{0}(G_{F_N}, \mathcal{L}(\pi^*E) \otimes |T G_N|^{1/2})$ denote the corresponding completed transverse principal symbol algebra (the $C^*$-completion of $0$-order symbols, viewed as sections over the transverse groupoid with values in endomorphisms of $\pi^*E$ tensored with the half-density bundle). The transverse principal symbol map extends to a continuous $*$-homomorphism
$$ \overline{\sigma} : \overline{\Psi}^{0,-\infty}(M,F,E) \longrightarrow \overline{S}^{0}(G_{F_N}, \mathcal{L}(\pi^*E) \otimes |T G_N|^{1/2}). $$
It is known that $\overline{\sigma}$ is surjective, and that it is injective for every bundle $E$ whenever the groupoid $G_{F_N}$ is amenable; in particular, when $G_{F_N}$ is not amenable, $\overline{\sigma}$ cannot be expected to be injective.

Problem: Determine geometric or analytic hypotheses on the Riemannian foliation $(M,F)$ (and on $E$) under which the completed transverse principal symbol map $\overline{\sigma}$ is injective.
artifact.status_search_result: The question is posed as an explicit open problem in the literature on noncommutative spectral geometry of Riemannian foliations. A web search did not turn up a published resolution; related work (Androulidakis–Skandalis and others) provides surjectivity of the symbol map and injectivity under amenability of the holonomy/transverse groupoid, but a general characterization of injectivity hypotheses for the completed transverse principal symbol map has not been found.

status_evidence.title: Pseudodifferential calculus on a singular foliation
status_evidence.snippet: Construction of pseudodifferential calculus associated with the holonomy groupoid; surjectivity of principal symbol map, injectivity issues tied to amenability.
status_evidence.claim: Background results on principal symbol maps in foliation pseudodifferential calculus indicate injectivity is tied to amenability of the groupoid.

status_evidence.title: Lie groupoids, pseudodifferential calculus, and index theory
status_evidence.snippet: Survey of pseudodifferential calculus on Lie groupoids and the role of amenability for the symbol exact sequence.
status_evidence.claim: No general characterization beyond amenability is given for injectivity of the completed principal symbol map in the transverse setting.
